question: Does the frozen cross-domain factor predictor plus consumed-only frame-level geometry calibration produce nontrivial, calibrated factors on four fresh Freiburg3 parents, before any reducer or task outcome is opened?

frozen_gates.A17_C01_ALL_CORE_POINT_FACTORS_NONTRIVIA: For depth shape, depth scale, support Brier, obstacle Brier and boundary distance, require positive four-parent macro improvement over the frozen constant prior and favorable improvement on at least 2 of 4 parents.
frozen_gates.A17_C02_HEIGHT_BOUNDED: Camera-height absolute log error must be <=0.25 parent macro and <=0.50 on the worst parent.
frozen_gates.A17_C03_RUNTIME_GRAVITY_NORMAL_EXACT: Runtime gravity support normal must have <=0.01 rad worst-parent error and dot(normal,gravity)>=0.999 on every frame.
frozen_gates.A17_C04_ALL_UNCERTAINTY_FAMILIES_PROPER_: Depth, support and boundary must each improve Gaussian NLL over the frozen homoscedastic prior and have nondecreasing observed absolute residual across four predicted-sigma quantiles.
frozen_gates.A17_C05_VALIDITY_NOT_COLLAPSED: Every frame must retain metric-scale validity, support validity and at least one evidence-valid pixel.
frozen_gates.A17_C06_EVIDENCE_VALIDITY_NO_MATERIAL_RE: Evidence-validity Brier regret versus the frozen prior must be <=0.02.
frozen_gates.A17_C07_ALL_PARENT_METRICS_FINITE: Every emitted parent metric is finite.
frozen_gates.A17_C08_TASK_AND_REDUCER_FIREWALL: No clearance, occupancy, reducer or task outcome is read during canary execution.

output_rule: Serialize all twelve factor tensors only if every frozen gate passes; otherwise serialize none and preserve a negative terminal.
successor_if_pass: Run FactorTensorAdapter and deterministic reducer seam verification on all twelve serialized factor tensors.
claim_ceiling: Fresh cross-parent learnability of Tier-A/Tier-B SuperTeacher factors. It is not final reducer task utility, deployment, product or safety evidence.
